pages.title: Bubbles in a Cinnamoroll Hood with Hearts Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles wears a floppy-eared Cinnamoroll hood in this printable coloring page, with a bow above her bangs, hearts in her eyes, and little clouds around her.

pages.title: Blossom Holding an Umbrella in the Rain Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom stands under an umbrella in this printable coloring page, wearing a raincoat tied with a bow and boots that reflect in the puddle below.

pages.title: Bubbles in Two Bunny Costume Poses Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows two views of Bubbles in bunny outfits, with a floppy-eared headband on the left and a rabbit-print bag on the right.

pages.title: Winter Blossom with a Snowflake Wand Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom holds a snowflake wand in this printable coloring page, wearing a fur-trimmed outfit with pointed ears as ice crystals and snowflakes float around her.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girl with a Skateboard and Flames Coloring Page
pages.description: A Powerpuff Girl points toward a flame in this printable coloring page, wearing a backward cap and a letter jacket with a skateboard behind her.

pages.title: Buttercup with Energy Swirls Around Her Fists Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup holds out both fists in this printable coloring page, with swirling energy around her hands, a star-shaped earring, and striped socks above her sneakers.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girl on Roller Skates in Three Poses Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a long-haired Powerpuff Girl in three roller-skating poses, with zigzag hair streaks and sparkles around one raised fist.

pages.title: Bubbles Beside a Girl in a Ball Gown Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles winks beside a girl in a layered ball gown in this printable coloring page, framed by floating hearts and a small crown.

pages.title: Blossom Landing in a City Street Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom braces one hand against the street in this printable coloring page, with her long ponytail sweeping behind her beneath a skyline of tall buildings.

pages.title: Buttercup Leaping Among Stars with Bold Outlines Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup reaches toward the viewer in this printable coloring page, with thick outlines around her outstretched glove and forward boot as oversized stars frame the leap.

pages.title: Buttercup in Rain Boots Under an Umbrella Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup stands in a rippling puddle in this printable coloring page, holding a curved umbrella handle and wearing a short rain cape tied with a bow.

pages.title: Buttercup Flying Through Lightning Bolts Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup flies with raised fists in this printable coloring page, with spiky hair, a flared skirt, and jagged lightning bolts between scattered stars.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Z Bubbles with Long Pigtails Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles poses with one hand on her hip in this printable coloring page, framed by long pigtails, floating hearts, and stars around her lettered belt.

pages.title: Buttercup Crouching on a Tiled Floor Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup crouches with one palm against the tiles in this printable coloring page, stretching her other arm back as her short hair and skirt flare outward.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Z Bubbles Over Cracked Pavement Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles crosses her arms above cracked pavement in this printable coloring page, with one knee raised and round bubbles drifting between her curled pigtails.

pages.title: Buttercup Leaping with Lightning Patterns Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup leaps toward the viewer in this printable coloring page, with zigzag skirt panels, a crescent on her boot sole, and stars behind her outstretched hand.

pages.title: Bubbles with Outstretched Arms and Sparkles Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles stretches both arms out as she floats in this printable coloring page, with curled pigtails, a zigzag headband, and sparkles around her flared skirt.

pages.title: Chibi Buttercup with a Scalloped Collar Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Buttercup tilts her head in this printable coloring page, with tousled hair, a scalloped collar, and a small spiral beside her face.

pages.title: Chibi Buttercup in a Belted Dress Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Buttercup smiles in this printable coloring page, with a tousled bob, a round belt buckle marked P, and short lines across her cheeks.

pages.title: Buttercup Floating in a Frilly Dress Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup floats with her hands behind her in this printable coloring page, with an angular fringe and scalloped trim on her dress and socks.

pages.title: Buttercup Standing with Her Arms Crossed Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup crosses her arms and ankles in this printable coloring page, with short flipped hair, a flared skirt, and rounded shoes against an open background.

pages.title: Blossom with a Big Bow and Flared Skirt Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom smiles beneath a large hair bow in this printable coloring page, with a sweeping ponytail, a flared skirt, and a round belt buckle marked P.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Bubbles and Headphone Sketches Coloring Page
pages.description: Pigtail sketches of Bubbles sit below three long-haired looks in this Powerpuff Girls printable coloring page, with headphones and lace-up high-tops at the center. The standing figure wears a cropped hoodie with drawstrings, and one of the side portraits shows a bubble of gum.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Blossom and Buttercup Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom frowns while Buttercup grins beside her in this Powerpuff Girls printable coloring page, with Blossom's tall bow and long hair sweeping behind her. Their banded dresses and rounded shoes sit against an open background, and Buttercup folds her arms across her chest.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls in Dressy Outfits with Bows Coloring Page
pages.description: Matching bows top the girls' shoes in this Powerpuff Girls printable coloring page, with Blossom in a layered skirt and Buttercup winking beside her. Bubbles carries a small purse, and a star at Buttercup's collar adds a detail to her jacket.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Blossom in Five Poses Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom fills this Powerpuff Girls printable coloring page in five poses, with her oversized bow and flowing hair framing a standing figure in the center. Smaller sketches show her crouching with crossed arms and raising a fist, among a heart, a sparkle, and a little flower.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Sticker-Style Trio Coloring Page
pages.description: Three sticker-style figures fill this Powerpuff Girls printable coloring page, with Blossom in lace-up sneakers, Bubbles in a pleated skirt, and Buttercup in a hoodie. Small hearts and stars surround them alongside doodles of a shark, a bunny, and an ice cream cone.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls with Bubble Gum and a Notebook Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles blows bubble gum beside Blossom and Buttercup in this Powerpuff Girls printable coloring page, with Blossom holding a spiral notebook against her school outfit. Bubbles's shirt has a cloud pattern, Buttercup wears a skull-and-crossbones top, and Blossom's broad ribbon sits over her blunt bangs.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Holding Hands with Pixel Hearts Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles, Blossom, and Buttercup link hands in midair in this Powerpuff Girls printable coloring page, with pixel hearts and small plus signs around the trio. Long rays spread out behind the girls, and Blossom's long hair follows the curve of her legs at the center.

pages.title: Chibi Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup Coloring Page
pages.description: Big eyes and small banded dresses distinguish the chibi versions of Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup in this printable coloring page from The Powerpuff Girls. Buttercup folds her arms, Bubbles leans inward, and Blossom's tall bow and curled hair frame the center of the trio.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Reading and Playing Games Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom reads on the couch while Buttercup holds a game controller in this Powerpuff Girls printable coloring page, with Bubbles lying beside an open coloring book. Pillows, scattered markers, and a small plush octopus fill the living room floor in front of the television.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls with Hearts and Stars Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles and Buttercup raise their fists beside Blossom in this Powerpuff Girls printable coloring page, with hearts and stars scattered around their ruffled dresses. Blossom's long hair sweeps behind the trio, and Bubbles wears a star clip near one pigtail above her wide eyes.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Blossom Bubbles and Buttercup in Their Classic Superhero Poses Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup stand together in this printable coloring page, with their hands at their waists, matching dresses, and smiling superhero expressions. The coloring sheet distinguishes Blossom's large bow, Bubbles' pigtails, and Buttercup's pointed bob, with broad open shapes and a plain background.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Flying Together Above the Townsville Skyline Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls fly over Townsville in this printable coloring page, with Blossom leading above Bubbles and Buttercup, clouds, and a row of buildings. Their outstretched arms and flowing hair emphasize the flight. Small windows and the central tower add finer shapes beneath the larger characters on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Blossom Standing Proudly with Her Large Bow and Long Hair Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom stands proudly in this printable coloring page, showing her oversized bow, long hair, small smile, and familiar dress with a wide waist stripe. Her hands rest at her sides in a confident pose. Broad hair sections and a plain background keep this character coloring sheet focused on her silhouette.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Bubbles Cuddling Her Stuffed Octopus Octi Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles cuddles Octi in this printable coloring page, holding the stuffed octopus against her dress while her pigtails curve outward beside her smiling face. Octi has a small top hat, round mouth, and dangling tentacles. The coloring sheet combines large character shapes with smaller details on the toy.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Buttercup Ready for Battle with Her Fists Raised Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup raises both fists in this printable coloring page, standing with her feet apart beneath sharply angled eyebrows and her familiar pointed bob haircut. The dress's broad waist stripe and curved shoes divide the open spaces. This coloring sheet uses a plain background to emphasize her battle-ready stance.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Blossom Freezing a Monster with Her Ice Breath Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom freezes a horned monster in this printable coloring page, blowing a stream of icy breath filled with snowflakes toward the block surrounding its feet. Her bow and long hair frame the action. The monster's striped horns, small fangs, and furry outline add different shapes to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Bubbles Talking to Birds Perched on a Park Fence Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles talks to two birds in this printable coloring page, lifting one arm beside a park fence beneath a large tree and rounded bushes. Both birds perch on the top rail with open beaks. Grass tufts and simple fence slats add small background details to the character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Buttercup Cuddling Her Treasured Security Blanket Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup cuddles her security blanket in this printable coloring page, sitting with her knees together, a small smile, and short marks on her cheeks. The blanket hangs down from her arms in soft folds. Large open hair and fabric sections give this coloring sheet a simple character-focused composition.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Blossom Answering the Superhero Hotline at Home Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom answers the superhero hotline in this printable coloring page, holding a telephone receiver beside a small round table, rotary dial, and curling cord. A curtained window and a rounded armrest establish the room. The coloring sheet balances her large bow and hair with smaller telephone and furniture details.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Bubbles Wearing Her Oversized Glasses From Bubblevision Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles wears oversized round glasses in this printable coloring page, smiling with her hands at her waist while clouds and Townsville buildings fill the background. Her pigtails frame the wide lenses, and her dress has a broad stripe. Smaller windows and grass tufts complete this Bubblevision coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Buttercup Roller Skating with the Derbytantes Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup roller skates with two Derbytantes in this printable coloring page, wearing protective pads and laced skates as the taller skaters follow behind her. Rounded knee pads, elbow guards, and rows of wheels provide smaller details. The coloring sheet leaves the background open around the three moving figures.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Rescuing a Kitten From a Tall Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls rescue a kitten in this printable coloring page, with Blossom reaching beside a thick tree branch while Bubbles and Buttercup hover nearby. The kitten has striped cheeks, pointed ears, and a curling tail. Curved branches and sparse leaves surround the figures on this rescue coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Confronting a Giant Monster in Downtown Townsville Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls confront a giant monster in this printable coloring page, flying above a city street beneath its spotted body, horns, and triangular teeth. Clawed hands and spikes give the creature a jagged silhouette. Rectangular buildings and a tall tower frame the confrontation on this Townsville coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Battling Mojo Jojo and His Giant Robot Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls battle Mojo Jojo's giant robot in this printable coloring page, flying toward its segmented arms while he grips controls inside a domed cockpit. Large mechanical claws contrast with the girls' rounded forms. City buildings, clouds, and action marks add surrounding details to this robot coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Facing the Rowdyruff Boys Above the City Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls face the Rowdyruff Boys in this printable coloring page, forming two opposing columns above a simple city skyline with their fists raised. Blossom faces the boy in a backward cap, with the other pairs below. The coloring sheet separates all six figures with broad white spaces.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Piloting Dynamo Against the Giant Fish Balloon Monster Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls pilot Dynamo in this printable coloring page, sitting behind its curved cockpit as the Giant Fish Balloon Monster towers above the street. The monster has clustered eyes, pointed spikes, and a long tail. Raised robot fists and block-shaped buildings fill the lower part of this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Blossom as Liberty Belle Twirling Her Lasso Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom becomes Liberty Belle in this printable coloring page, twirling a large lasso above her winged helmet, star-decorated costume, flowing cape, and pointed boots. A bird-shaped crest sits between the helmet wings. The coloring sheet contrasts the rope's wide looping curve with the smaller costume and wristband details.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Bubbles as Harmony Bunny Riding Her Pogo Stick Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles rides a pogo stick as Harmony Bunny in this printable coloring page, wearing a long-eared hood, small cape, and rabbit emblem on her costume. Her hands hold the horizontal bar above the footrests and spring. Rounded shapes and open background space keep this costume coloring sheet uncluttered.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Buttercup as Mange Wearing Her Hooded Costume on a Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: Buttercup stands on a rooftop as Mange in this printable coloring page, wearing a pointed hood and a broad cape fastened with a round clasp. Her hands rest at her waist above the roof ledge. Smaller buildings behind her provide a simple city setting for this hooded-character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Floating Beside Professor Utonium and a Chemical X Bottle in His Laboratory Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls float beside Professor Utonium in this printable coloring page, gathering near a stoppered Chemical X bottle and test tubes in his laboratory. The Professor gestures toward the tabletop in his long coat and tie. Large character shapes sit above smaller glassware details on this laboratory coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Giving Professor Utonium a Family Hug Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls give Professor Utonium a family hug in this printable coloring page, crowding around his shoulders and arms while he kneels and smiles. All four figures have cheerful closed-eye expressions. The coloring sheet combines Blossom's bow, Bubbles' pigtails, and striped dresses with the Professor's coat pockets.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Bunny Protecting Blossom Bubbles and Buttercup Coloring Page
pages.description: Bunny protects Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup in this printable coloring page, spreading her arms across the foreground while the smaller girls cluster around her. Her uneven eyes and two front teeth distinguish the large figure. A city skyline and tower form the background of this protective-group coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Bliss Reuniting with Blossom Bubbles and Buttercup in Townsville Coloring Page
pages.description: Bliss reunites with Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup in this printable coloring page, opening her arms as the three sisters float above the Townsville skyline. Her headband and long hair distinguish her larger foreground figure. Broad dress sections and small building windows offer different coloring areas across this reunion coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Flying Beside Bullet the Superpowered Squirrel Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup fly beside Bullet the superpowered squirrel, whose curled tail and pointed ears stand out. Three rounded clouds surround the group, while the girls' bow, pigtails, and angular bob distinguish their silhouettes on a coloring sheet with broad open spaces.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Bubbles Listening to Talking Dog Outside Her House Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles listens to Talking Dog outside her house in this printable coloring page, with her hands clasped beside his collar and round identification tag. The house has three circular windows and a short entrance path, while bushes and scattered grass frame the pair. Long ears and an outlined back patch distinguish the dog on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Listening to Ms Keane Read a Story at Pokey Oaks Kindergarten Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls sit on a round rug in this printable coloring page while Ms Keane reads an open book at Pokey Oaks Kindergarten. A window, a potted flower, and books on a wall shelf establish the classroom setting. The coloring sheet combines broad dress and rug areas with smaller book and furniture details.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Mayor of Townsville Calling the Hotline From His Office Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mayor of Townsville calls the hotline from his office in this printable coloring page, holding a telephone receiver beside his top hat and monocle. His large moustache and bow tie fill the foreground, with a curly cord crossing his jacket. The coloring sheet adds a telephone base, desk drawers, and the city skyline beyond the window.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Ms Bellum Carrying City Paperwork Beside the Mayor Coloring Page
pages.description: Ms Bellum carries a tall stack of city paperwork beside the Mayor in this printable coloring page, with her large curls concealing her face. Her fitted jacket, skirt, and heels contrast with his small figure, top hat, and flower lapel decoration. Outlined paper layers and floor tiles add smaller sections to this character coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Mojo Jojo Operating the Controls in His Volcano Observatory Coloring Page
pages.description: Mojo Jojo operates his observatory controls in this printable coloring page, gripping a long lever while pressing a large button beneath his striped helmet. A smoking volcano appears through the curved window behind him. His cape, high collar, boots, and pointed teeth provide distinct shapes on a coloring sheet with a simple control panel and open background areas.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Princess Morbucks Flying in Her Armored Suit and Crown Coloring Page
pages.description: Princess Morbucks flies above Townsville in this printable coloring page, wearing a jeweled crown and an armored suit with shoulder plates and a buckled belt. Bows sit beside her curled hair, and jet trails extend beneath her boots. The small skyline and two clouds leave the character prominent, with large armor sections and smaller crown details to color.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls HIM Raising His Lobster Claws in His Ruffled Costume and Curled Boots Coloring Page
pages.description: HIM raises his lobster claws in this printable coloring page, displaying a ruffled costume, a square belt buckle, and tall boots with curled pointed toes. His grin, pointed ears, and curling beard define the face, while scalloped cuffs echo the collar and hem. This full-body coloring sheet leaves the background mostly open around the angular pose.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Fuzzy Lumpkins Playing His Banjo Outside His Woodland Cabin Coloring Page
pages.description: Fuzzy Lumpkins plays his banjo outside a woodland cabin in this printable coloring page, sitting on a tree stump with his antennae extending overhead. The instrument's strings, tuning pegs, and circular rim add narrow details beside his shaggy fur and ragged overalls. Pine trees, grass, and the cabin's chimney complete the outdoor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Gangreen Gang Gathered Around Their Townsville Junkyard Hideout Coloring Page
pages.description: The Gangreen Gang gathers outside its Townsville junkyard hideout in this printable coloring page, with five distinct figures arranged before a patched wooden shed. Ace's sunglasses, Snake's long neck, Big Billy's large belt, Lil' Arturo's cap, and Grubber's hanging tongue distinguish the group. A chain-link fence, discarded tires, and rough roof panels add background detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Amoeba Boys Standing Beside a Keep Off the Grass Sign Coloring Page
pages.description: The Amoeba Boys stand beside a Keep Off the Grass sign in this printable coloring page, wearing matching brimmed hats above their differently shaped bodies. The sign uses a crossed-out footprint over grass rather than lettering. A tree, bushes, cloud, and distant buildings surround the trio on a coloring sheet with broad flowing outlines and sparse small details.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Rowdyruff Boys Brick Boomer and Butch Striking Villain Poses Coloring Page
pages.description: Brick, Boomer, and Butch strike villain poses in this printable coloring page, with Brick crossing his arms above the other two Rowdyruff Boys. His backward cap, Boomer's swept fringe, and Butch's spiked hair make the characters easy to distinguish. The coloring sheet keeps the background blank around their striped outfits, raised fists, and wide shoes.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Playing on the Swings at the Pokey Oaks Playground Coloring Page
pages.description: Blossom, Bubbles, and Buttercup sit on three swings in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath the large frame at the Pokey Oaks playground. Each girl holds her own pair of ropes, with shoes dangling above scattered grass. A tree, rounded bushes, and a distant skyline complete the coloring sheet, combining long straight lines with familiar curved character shapes.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Blossom on Guitar Buttercup on Bass and Bubbles on Drums Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows the Powerpuff Girls playing music, with Blossom on guitar, Buttercup on bass, and Bubbles raising drumsticks behind a drum kit. Cymbals, instrument strings, and tuning pegs introduce smaller enclosed shapes beside the large drums and dresses. An amplifier, window, and hanging lamp establish the room around the trio on this musical coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Bubbles Blowing Soap Bubbles in Townsville Park Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles blows soap bubbles in Townsville park in this printable coloring page, holding an open jar while lifting a circular wand to her puckered mouth. Three bubbles of different sizes float beside her pigtails. A bench, rounded bush, and tufts of grass give the coloring sheet a simple setting with broad open areas around the main figure.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Sleeping Side By Side in Their Shared Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls sleep side by side in their shared bed in this printable coloring page, tucked beneath one broad blanket with separate pillows. Heart shapes decorate the headboard and footboard, while a crescent moon and stars appear through tied-back curtains. The coloring sheet pairs large bedding areas with smaller pajama collars, window panes, and decorative details.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Having a Pillow Fight in Their Pajamas at a Slumber Party Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls have a pillow fight at a slumber party in this printable coloring page, with Blossom jumping above Bubbles and Buttercup on the bed. Their pajamas display flower, dot, and star patterns, and loose feathers float around the pillows. Curved blanket folds and the bedposts add further shapes to this bedroom coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Wearing Santa Hats and Decorating a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls decorate a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, wearing Santa hats while Blossom stands on a ladder to hang a star. Bubbles and Buttercup hold a scalloped garland near the lower branches, beside round baubles and the tree's pot. The coloring sheet offers large hat and branch areas alongside smaller ornament loops and ladder rungs.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls in Witch Cat and Vampire Halloween Costumes Beside Jack O Lanterns Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls wear witch, cat, and vampire costumes in this printable coloring page, gathering beside two jack-o-lanterns with triangular eyes and broad grins. Blossom holds a broom beneath a buckled hat, Bubbles has cat ears and a curved tail, and Buttercup wears a high-collared cape. These costume accessories provide distinct smaller sections within the open character outlines.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Exchanging Heart Shaped Valentine Cards Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls exchange heart-shaped Valentine cards in this printable coloring page, with Blossom holding one above Bubbles and Buttercup as they share another. Smaller hearts float around the group, and the girls' bow, pigtails, and short bob remain prominent. This coloring sheet keeps the setting minimal, leaving broad unpatterned spaces inside the cards and dresses.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Building a Sandcastle Together at the Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: The Powerpuff Girls build a sandcastle at the beach in this printable coloring page, working around three towers topped by a small waving flag. Bubbles and Buttercup kneel beside the walls while Blossom stands behind the central tower. A bucket, spade, shell, and simple sea waves add recognizable seaside details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Powerpuff Girls Bubbles Meeting Donny the Unicorn in a Flower Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: Bubbles meets Donny the unicorn in a flower meadow in this printable coloring page, raising one arm beside his spiral horn and sweeping mane. Three large flowers fill the foreground, with small grass tufts and low bushes behind the pair. The coloring sheet leaves roomy sections across Donny's body, curved tail, and Bubbles' familiar dress.
